name: AGNT, Inc.
summary:
AGNT (AGNT) reported breakeven results on revenue of $1.45 billion for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.03 per share on revenue of $1.41 billion. The company missed consensus estimates by 100.00%.

The company said it expects third quarter revenue of $1.35 billion to $1.45 billion and 2026 revenue of $4.85 billion to $5.15 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $1.36 billion for the quarter ending September 30, 2026 and revenue of $5.02 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

AGNT, Inc. is the global parent company of eXp Realty®, the most agent-centric™ real estate brokerage on the planet, NextHome, Inc., an award-winning national real estate franchise, FrameVR.io, a virtual collaboration platform, and SUCCESS® Enterprises, a leading personal development and media brand for entrepreneurs.
subject: AGNT Missed Consensus Estimates
